p2.title: Add sequential-state and uncapped-path coverage
p2.body: The implementation patches _previous_weights and artifacts correctly by inspection, but the tests do not prove the capped state is consumed on the next evaluation or that a no-op cap preserves weights/cash exactly. Non-blocking review coverage gap.

p2.title: Rerun catalog API with writable pytest temp root
p2.body: The focused strategy catalog passed, but the catalog API suite could not complete because the environment's temp-directory/ACL setup either denied cleanup or removed tmp_path when the tmpdir plugin was disabled.

p3.title: Existing pytest cache ACL warning
p3.body: Both successful pytest runs emitted a pre-existing PytestCacheWarning for E:\code\stock\Vibe-Trading\.pytest_cache.
